laprace.hud.no_track: No track here (]: pick, O: record)
laprace.msg.no_track: No track selected (] to pick one, O to record one).
laprace.msg.busy: Not during a race (R aborts it).
laprace.msg.rec_no_boat: Sit in a boat on the start line first.
laprace.msg.rec_start: Recording the track (O again at the start)
laprace.msg.rec_open: The end is far from the start: drive the lap back to the start line. Nothing saved.
laprace.config.title: Lap Race
laprace.config.race_laps.tip: Laps of a race started with R.
laprace.config.countdown.tip: Start lights: one light per second, GO when they are all on.
laprace.config.finish_timeout.tip: After the winner finishes, the others have this long, then DNF.
laprace.config.results_time.tip: How long the results stay on screen.
laprace.config.sectors.tip: The lap is split into this many equal sectors (split times, sector lights).
laprace.config.gap_to_leader.tip: Time gap to the leader, or to the boat ahead (interval).
laprace.config.chat_laps.tip: Also write every lap of yours in the chat.
laprace.config.track.tip: The track in use (] cycles them). Recorded ones are in config/laprace/tracks.
laprace.config.auto_track.tip: Off the chosen track, switch to the nearest one.
laprace.config.track_others.tip: Players (and named boats) in view on the track join the board.
laprace.config.join_distance.tip: A boat this close to the track joins the board.
laprace.config.off_track.tip: Further than this from the track in practice: the lap is not timed.
laprace.config.reset_pb: Delete personal best of this track
laprace.config.hud_scale.tip: On top of the game's GUI scale.
laprace.config.show_board.tip: Positions, names and gaps (I toggles it).
laprace.config.show_popups.tip: Sector splits, lap times, personal best, final lap, finish.
laprace.config.replace_boathud.tip: Hide Boat HUD's panel; our speedometer shows its speed, drift angle, g and ping.
laprace.config.replace_boathud.missing: Boat HUD is not installed: the speedometer measures by itself.
laprace.config.unit.tip: "As Boat HUD" uses the unit set in Boat HUD's settings.
laprace.config.show_inputs.tip: Throttle (W), brake (S), left / right next to the dial.
laprace.msg.cruise_no_boat: Sit in a boat on the track first.
laprace.config.cruise_calm.tip: Higher = calmer steering, slower to react.
laprace.config.cruise_camera: Camera looks where the boat goes
laprace.config.cruise_camera.tip: While the autopilot drives (the bow points into corners on ice).
laprace.config.fuel.tip: Fuel burns with the distance driven, more on the throttle than coasting. Refuel standing in a pit box (black or yellow concrete): a full tank in 6 s. Empty: the engine dies, the car only steers. Off: the gauge stays full.
laprace.config.gt_fonts.tip: Inter and Orbitron (OFL) instead of the game's pixel font.
laprace.hud.fuel_off: Fuel is off in the settings
laprace.config.notify.tip: Track found, race start, autopilot...: as cards at the side of the HUD, as AlinLib toasts (top right) or in the chat. Results stay in the chat.
laprace.msg.pit_auto: Pit stop: the autopilot takes the car
laprace.msg.pit_out: Out of the pits: you drive
laprace.config.pit_mode.tip: Automatic (GT): turn into the pit lane and the autopilot drives in, stops at the box and drives out - slower than a good manual stop. Manual: all yours. Needs the pit lane recorded once (key L).
laprace.config.pit_speed.tip: Speed limit in the pit lane (the automatic stop drives at it).
laprace.config.pit_stop.tip: Time standing in the box, plus up to 6 s for an empty tank.
laprace.config.cooldown.tip: After the finish the autopilot drives a lap and parks in the box (or stops after the line if the track has no pit lane).
laprace.pits.title: PIT BOX
laprace.pits.hint: Click a box to take it  ·  ← → and Enter  ·  Esc - close
laprace.pits.no_lane: No pit lane recorded for this track: drive it once with L (start, at a box, back on the track).
laprace.pits.not_loaded: The pits are not loaded: come closer to them and open this again.
laprace.pits.no_boxes: No boxes next to the pit lane: a box is a black and a yellow concrete block side by side.
laprace.msg.pit_locked: In the pits the autopilot drives until you are back on the track
laprace.config.engine_sound.tip: The boat sounds like a turbocharged V8: revs, throttle, turbo whistle, blow-off valve.
laprace.config.engine_volume.tip: Loudness of the engine (only Master volume affects it too).
laprace.config.car_model.tip: Every boat is drawn as the F1 car (Figura avatar "F1" by CoBeHok), with its driver in your skin.
laprace.config.livery_folder.tip: Your own livery is livery.png in this folder (a square of 128, 256 or 512 pixels). Paint over livery-template.png. You see it at once, others once a judge approves it.
laprace.config.livery_upload.tip: Sends livery.png to the judges. Until it is approved, others see your car in the standard livery.
laprace.config.site_code.tip: A code to sign in on the site with: enter it on the Liveries tab. Good once, for 10 minutes. Copied to the clipboard.
laprace.config.garage.tip: The garage: every livery, the car in each. Your own livery and sending it to the judges are there too. Key G.
laprace.garage.title: Garage
laprace.garage.own_hint: Your own is livery.png in the mod's folder (paint over livery-template.png). Others see it once a judge approves it.
laprace.config.line_mode.tip: Full: the whole line ahead. Braking: only where to slow down. A server race's creator may forbid it.
laprace.config.line_style.tip: Chevrons on a glowing band, the band alone, or the chevrons alone.
laprace.config.line_reach.tip: How far ahead the line shows: 40, 70 or 110 blocks.
laprace.config.line_color.tip: By speed: from how you drive - green go, yellow ease off, red brake. By track: where the line itself speeds up and slows down.
laprace.config.ghost_with.tip: A see-through car drives with each of your laps: your best lap of this track or the track record (from the server). Only you see it; you drive through it. Not in the server's races.
laprace.config.hud_preset.tip: Full: everything. Minimal: the lap time and the speedometer. Own: pick yourself.
laprace.ok.sent: OK sent to the pit crew (%s)
laprace.ok.offline: OK not sent: no link to the server
laprace.ok.failed.jam: OK did not get through: the radio is jammed
laprace.ok.failed.nocrew: OK not sent: no pit crew set for you by the judges
laprace.ok.failed.offline: OK did not arrive: your pit crew is not online
laprace.garage.catalog_empty: No approved liveries yet. Paint your own: livery.png in the mod's folder.
laprace.garage.drop_hint: Your own livery: choose a PNG or drop it on the game window (a square of 128, 256 or 512). Others see it once a judge approves it.
laprace.garage.file_size: A square of 128, 256 or 512 pixels, please
laprace.garage.mine_hint: Hover over a livery of yours for the three dots in its corner: send to the judges, change, delete. A PNG can be dropped on the game window too.
laprace.config.car_camera.tip: Blocks up or down from the normal eye height while driving the car (the avatar uses -0.30).
laprace.config.online.tip: Signs in with your Minecraft account (as joining an online server, no password) and sends your laps and live position for the website.
laprace.config.server_url.tip: Address of the Lap Race server.
laprace.config.proxy.tip: How to reach the Lap Race server. Off: directly (or through a VPN if it covers the whole system). System: the proxy a VPN app set in its "system proxy" mode. Own address: the HTTP proxy below. The Minecraft server is not affected.
laprace.config.proxy_address.tip: For "Own address": host:port of an HTTP proxy, e.g. 127.0.0.1:10809 (a VPN app's local port). SOCKS will not do.
laprace.msg.online: Lap Race server: signed in as %s
laprace.msg.online_admin: Lap Race server: signed in as %s (admin)
laprace.msg.online_failed: Lap Race server unreachable, retrying in the background
laprace.race.title: Race
laprace.race.offline: Not connected to the Lap Race server: local race only.
laprace.race.server_running: A server race is on: only its host can stop it (R)
laprace.race.new: %s is setting up a race: %s, %s laps. Join with R
laprace.race.new_tour: %s is setting up a tournament race: %s, %s laps. Join with R
laprace.race.err.busy: There is a race already: run or cancel it first
laprace.race.err.not_admin: Only the admin creates tournament races
laprace.race.err.no_track: Pick a track (]) - races are on routes 1-6 only
laprace.race.err.closed: Sign-up for this race is closed
laprace.race.err.not_host: Only the race's host can do that
laprace.race.err.banned: You may not race in this one now
laprace.race.err.no_tournament: You do not race in tournaments
laprace.race.err.offline: Not connected to the Lap Race server
laprace.race.status.grid: the autopilot lines up the grid
laprace.quali.started: Qualifying: %s min on %s - the best lap counts
laprace.quali.flag: Time is up: a lap begun before the flag still counts
laprace.quali.new: %s is setting up qualifying: %s, %s min. Join with R
laprace.quali.new_tour: %s is setting up tournament qualifying: %s, %s min. Join with R
laprace.ui.reset_done: Personal bests on this track reset
laprace.config.start_lights.tip: How a local race starts: a countdown, or lights - five red ones come on a second apart and go out after a random pause.
laprace.config.fuel_rate.tip: How fast fuel burns outside the server's events (in one, as its host set it). ×1: a full tank lasts about 27 km flat out.
laprace.config.ghost.tip: A see-through car drives your best lap of this track, starting with each of your laps; the gap to it shows at the top. Only you see it, and you drive through it. Not shown in the server's races.
laprace.config.ui_theme.tip: How the mod's windows look: race (R), settings, box selection.
